{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Stagecoach Lateral''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=59214|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Tennessee Gas Pipeline Station 319, Susquehanna County, Pennsylvania to Stagecoach Storage Field, Tioga County, New York.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2000-01-13/html/00-789.htm|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
===Main Line===
*'''Owner: '''Central New York Oil and Gas Co LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=59214|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''487 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

*'''Diameter: '''30 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2000-01-13/html/00-789.htm|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=59214|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
